note: The derivative limit is `Bid.A04`. The charge limit with factor ξ^{-1} is `Bid.A05`, and the normalized rotation limit is given per d with U chosen in `lens`. The passage via ξ_k/c_star → 1 to both limits along one sequence for all d is not stated.

proof_context.conclusion: `Watches`: for scalings tracking beyond thresholds, `ConLap` says `r_k` times the transported derivative tends to `R.T.W.deriv`, the free derivative.

snippet.text:
def A05 : Prop := ∀ {G : Gauge} {C : Family G} {S : Table C.book} (H : S.Hierarchy) (V : DiffPlan S),
    V.Inclusions S → V.Derivatives S → ∀ (R : MaxwellData C) (J : S.Stress) (d : ℕ)  (p : Climb.Parts S) (Y : Ward.SpinRows S),
    Pre H V J p Y →
    Watches J R.T H.spin R.hT.spin V (fun X => (ConLap X p d ((R.T.κ:ℝ) • R.T.W.deriv) (fun i => X.r i/X.xi i)) ∧
      ∀ j : Spin.Ind, Tendsto (fun i => (X.xi i)⁻¹ • (Spin.transport Y (X.U i d) j)) atTop (𝓝 (R.T.κ • Spin.leaf R.T.K.lie d j)))

proof_context.conclusion: `Watches`: the same derivative limit with factor `r/ξ` and `(X.ξ i)⁻¹ • transport Y (X.U i d) j → κ • leaf` for the spin rows.

snippet.text:
lens : V.Inclusions S → V.Derivatives S → ∀ c, Crystal H.basis.kernel V I.J I.p I.Y c →
    (∀ n (x : Points n), x∈conf n → Still V (c⁻¹ • I.Y) x) → ∀ d, ∃ U w, Spin.Tilt W.T.K H.basis.kernel.spin W.hT.spin (c⁻¹ • I.Y) d U w

proof_context.conclusion: `lens` gives, for every `d`, `U` and `w` with `Spin.Tilt` for `c⁻¹ • I.Y`, the rotation-generator limit.
